form.question: Do you hold specified foreign financial assets whose total value exceeds the reporting threshold for your filing status and residence?
form.notes: PRODUCES NO 1040 LINE. It is a disclosure attached to the return, triggered independently of the FBAR. Schedule B Part III states in its own margin: 'Additionally, you may be required to file Form 8938, Statement of Specified Foreign Financial Assets. See instructions.' The Instructions for Schedule B, Part III state: 'Regardless of whether you are required to file FinCEN Form 114 (FBAR), you may be required to file Form 8938, Statement of Specified Foreign Financial Assets, with your income tax return. Failure to file Form 8938 may result in penalties and extension of the statute of limitations.' Also pointed at by the FATCA filing requirement checkbox on Forms 1099-INT, 1099-OID and 1099-DIV. THE REPORTING THRESHOLDS WERE NOT READ for this part - they live in the Form 8938 instructions and vary by filing status and by whether the taxpayer lives abroad.
